apps.name: Rex
apps.subtitle: 支持 Dolby Vision 与 AI 字幕的媒体播放器
apps.localizedDescription:
Rex 是一款全能的本地与网盘媒体播放器：
• 播放内核：FFmpeg、Dolby Vision（libdovi）、AV1（libdav1d）、SRT 流、SMB 共享、onnxruntime AI 画质增强
• 元数据：TMDB / Trakt / IMDB / 豆瓣 / 烂番茄，片头片尾自动跳过（theIntroDB）
• 字幕：OpenSubtitles / Assrt / 射手网，ASR 语音识别（FunASR），12+ 家 LLM 字幕翻译
• 网盘/服务器：115 网盘、Plex、Drivemby
• 弹幕、脚本中心、AI 推荐

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Rex uses Face ID to verify your identity and unlock protected viewing environments.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Rex uses your local network to find NAS devices and file shares, and to transfer library indexes between your devices.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save captured video frames to your photo library.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Rex uses speech recognition to turn dialogue from the video you are playing into subtitles when you enable speech recognition subtitles.
